admission.justification: A fail-loud field-set test prevents an operator believing an unconsumed runtime setting selected another daemon or install.

applicability: Parsing a present paseoRuntime authority block.
exclusions: Unknown keys outside this nested block retain the outer parser rules.
statement: The `paseoRuntime` settings block holds the five operational facts (installPrefix, home, listen, providers, embed) and one optional `version` key that is no longer the pin; a key outside that set is refused when the block is parsed.
